verses.text: Israel’s whole community left the Wilderness of Sin and traveled from place to place, following Yahweh’s instructions. They camped at Rephidim, but there was no water for them to drink. 🏜️
So the people argued with Moses: ‘Give us water to drink!’ Moses said, ‘Why are you coming at me? Why are you testing Yahweh?’ 😠
The people were thirsty, and they complained to Moses: ‘Why bring us out of Egypt? So our children and livestock can die of thirst out here?’ 😟
Moses cried out to Yahweh: ‘What am I supposed to do with these people? They’re almost ready to stone me!’ 😰
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Go out ahead of the people. Take some of Israel’s elders with you, and take the staff you used to strike the Nile. Go. 🪵
‘I’ll be standing there in front of you on the rock at Horeb. Strike the rock, and water will come out for the people to drink.’ Moses did this while Israel’s elders watched. 💧
Moses named the place Massah and Meribah, because Israel’s people argued there and tested Yahweh by asking, ‘Is Yahweh really with us or not?’ ❓
Then Amalek came to fight Israel at Rephidim. ⚔️
Moses told Joshua, ‘Choose some men for us and go fight Amalek. Tomorrow I’ll stand on the hilltop with God’s staff in my hand.’ 🗣️
Joshua did what Moses told him and fought Amalek. Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the hilltop. 🏔️
Whenever Moses held his hand up, Israel had the advantage. Whenever he lowered his hand, Amalek had the advantage. ✋
Moses’ hands got tired. So they put a stone under him and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur stood beside him, one on each side, holding up his hands until sunset. 🤝
Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the sword. ⚔️
Yahweh told Moses, ‘Write this down in a scroll as a reminder, and make sure Joshua hears it: I’ll completely erase Amalek’s memory from under the sky.’ 📜
Moses built an altar and named it ‘Yahweh Is My Banner.’ 🏳️
He said, “Yahweh has sworn: Yahweh will be at war with Amalek from generation to generation.” ⚔️
